limitations: Single-day distributions reflect reporting and within-person variation, not usual intake distributions or causal dose-response ranges.
Day-one dietary weights differ from fasting/MEC weights; cycles are analyzed separately, not pooled or summed.
2021-2023 moved the first recall from in-person to telephone; historical differences can reflect mode/composition changes.
Published UPF means use adults 19+, whereas nutrient reconstruction uses adults 20+; no automatic matched population is implied.
UPF microdata/Nova coding are not reconstructed here; published tables supply means and SEs, not individual distributions.
Total sugars are not added sugars, protein amount is not protein quality, and saturated fat is not an overall fat-quality index.
No imputation or item-nonresponse reweighting; source measurement error, food-code changes and reporting bias remain outside sampling intervals.
Observed intake bounds and quantiles are descriptive, not validated intervention ranges; baselines do not identify causal effects.
